=== sprites
sprite $foo1 {
  FFFFFFFFFFFFFFF
  F0123456789ABCF
  FFFFFFFFFFFFFFF
}
sprite $bar [8x4/8] {
  0-0F0-0F
  z_z_z_z_
}
sprite $baz [6x3/4] 0123456789AB
sprite $col [2x2/color] {
  ..,,
  zzyy
}
sprite $bad [2x2/3] {
 00
}
A -> B : <$foo1>
=== sprite gray bad level

  FG
}

}

=== sprite svg
sprite $s <svg viewBox="0 0 10 10"><rect width="10" height="10"/></svg>
sprite $m <svg viewBox="0 0 10 10">
<rect width="10" height="10"/>
</svg>
A -> B
=== sprite base64
sprite $img data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAEAAAABCAYAAAAfFcSJAAAADUlEQVR42mNkYPhfDwAChwGA60e6kgAAAABJRU5ErkJggg==
A -> B
=== sprite base64 not image
sprite $img data:image/png;base64,AAAA
A -> B
=== sprite file missing
sprite $f nofile.png
=== sprite jar missing
sprite $f jar:nofile
=== sprite stdlib
sprite $foo #nolib#bar
=== sprite stdlib svg
sprite $foo :nolib:bar
=== sprite color bad
sprite $col [2x2/color] {
  !!##
  ab
}
